info.name: Online Exam API
info.description:
Collection covering the currently-implemented routes: auth (signup/login/forgot-password flow) and quiz (create/update/list/get). Base URL and a few IDs are collection variables so you can fill them in once and reuse them across requests.

Auth: Login sets an `accessToken` cookie on success, which Postman's cookie jar carries automatically to later requests against the same `baseUrl` — run Login once per session before hitting quiz routes, all of which now require authentication.

Roles: every new user registers as role `user`. Create/Update Quiz require role `admin`, so to exercise those two requests you'll need to manually set a user's `role` to `admin` in the database first (there's no self-serve way to become admin through the API, by design). List/Get Quiz work for either role.

Note on `questions`/`instructions`: these are JSON-stringified inside a text form-data field (multipart can't carry nested arrays natively) — the server parses that string back into an array before validation. `instructions` on Create Quiz is currently omitted below since only `questions` has that parsing wired up so far.

request.description: firstName/lastName require min length 2. password/confirmPassword must match. On success, an accessToken cookie is set and the created user + token are returned in the response body.
Note: this route is a GET with a body in the current implementation. On success, an accessToken cookie is set and the token is also returned in the response body.
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the given email if a matching user exists. The OTP expires in 2 minutes.
Requires the OTP to have been verified first. newPassword must be 8+ chars with at least one uppercase letter, one number, and one symbol, and must match confirmPassword.

request.description: Requires an admin session (log in as a user with role=admin first). time: 30-120. passingThreshold: 20-100 (optional, defaults server-side if omitted). questions: 1-10 items, JSON-stringified (see collection-level note); each question needs 1+ options and 1+ correctOptionIndex; a 'radio' question must have exactly 1 correct index. quizPhoto is required.
Requires an admin session (log in as a user with role=admin first). All fields are optional (partial update) — only send the ones you want to change. quizPhoto is optional here, unlike on create.
Requires any authenticated user (user or admin). page/size are optional — omit both to get all matching quizzes without pagination metadata.
